teacher_info.about_teacher:
As a teacher, I love one-on-one classes. I listen to your goals and we go from there.

I offer 2 types of lessons to choose from, that we alter together to reach your goals:
- Conversational Class ==> through interesting conversations, I help you build vocabulary, grammar,  and pronunciation. Perfect for both kids and adults who want to practice and improve!
- Traditional Class ==> with 3 course books, we tackle all kind of grammar topics or industry-specific vocabulary based on your needs. This is a structured, well-prepared class for absolute beginners and people looking to get better in Dutch! No need to buy additional course books, I send you screenshots of all the pages ;)
teacher_info.teaching_style:
With the conversational classes, we dive into your passions. We'll explore relevant articles together, creating a positive learning experience. 
Dive into 'Dutch in 3 Months' or 'Basic Dutch' for creating some solid basics, from alphabet to sentence structure, boosting your confidence to converse fluently. These basics you will have to drill, because you can't build a house if you don't have a good foundation. 
Already have a good foundation, but you want classes to improve? 'Intermediate Dutch' will get you forward with challenging topics and in-depth grammar. 
On top of all these courses, i make my own exercises for you, to ensure that you retain everything you've seen with me.

course_info.trial_description:
Everyone is different and so everyone learns different as well. That is why, in this class, you tell me about you and your reasons why you want to learn Dutch, so I can put together a personal lesson plan where you have as much input in as you want. If it is for immigration reasons, business opportunities, travel or simply just to challenge yourself,... 

Whatever the reason, I respect it immensely that you invest in your own development, which is why I want to make sure that my teaching skills and methods are the right ones for you in our first, very cheap, lesson. 
The more you talk about it, the better I can create a curriculum catered to you!

You will have the chance to discuss how you want the lessons to be structured (classic, with games, roleplay, lots of practices,...) and which language you want me to use during our time together (English or Dutch). I also like to hear your background and where you come from.

Don't be shy about your current level of Dutch or English. We can both use a translating website or even use our hands and feet (a Dutch saying, not literally).

Hopefully talk to you soon! - Hopelijk tot gauw!

pro_course_detail.title: Structured Classes /// From Absolute Beginners to Advanced - Dutch in 3 Months / Basic & Intermediate Dutch
pro_course_detail.description:
In the course for Absolute Beginners, we follow the coursebook "Dutch in 3 Months" by publishing company DK. We start from the very beginning (the alphabet) to more complex grammar (f.e. verb tenses), so you can explain yourself and your thoughts on an everyday level. 

If you are already at a certain level, we follow the coursebook "Intermediate Dutch" by publishing company "Routledge". If you are familiar with certain topics in a chapter, we can go over it very quickly as a refresh exercise, or skip it all together. 

I would recommend purchasing the books (hardback or digital) so you can practice outside of our classes, however I do send you screenshots of the chapter after every class. The book for Absolute Beginners says 3 months, but how fast we will go is entirely personalized to you and learning type. A downside however is that this book has quite a dry presentation, but I do my very best to make it a little bit more interesting. 
With these books, the free audio app that comes with it and a tutor guiding you, learning Dutch will become a lot easier. 

You can always contact me to ask for the cheapest online shop to buy "Dutch in 3 Months" or "Intermediate Dutch". Unfortunately, I cannot provide a free copy.

We will go through the basics of reading and writing, focus on basic topics like greetings, small talk, introducing and talking about yourself, hobbies, ordering at a restaurant, asking for directions. I specialize in a structured, step-by-step approach designed for beginners: 
🔺 Grammar: Understand the structure of the language with clear and simple explanations, so you can start building your own sentences and express your own thoughts.
🔺 Pronunciation: Thanks to my passion for accent and pronunciation, you will speak with confidence using proven techniques to master Norwegian phonetics. 
🔺 Reading & Listening: Build your comprehension skills with engaging texts and audio. Understanding the language first is essential, so you can start speaking. 
🔺 Speaking Practice: Reinforce what you've learned with light conversational practice in each session. 
🔺 Homework (Optional): For those who want to deepen their learning between sessions, I will offer homework assignments, short tasks from grammar drills to watching YouTube videos in Norwegian with the goal to maximize your learning process. 

🙋 Who is this course for? 
This course is perfect for absolute beginners, false beginners, or anyone looking to revisit the basics with a clear, structured method by a friendly professional.

pro_course_detail.title: 🇸🇪 Swedish from Scratch
pro_course_detail.description:

Whether you're drawn to Swedish culture, preparing for a trip, living, studying or working in Sweden, or simply wanting to read Astrid Lidgren in the original language, this course will help you build a solid foundation, allowing you to start speaking Swedish. 

What you can expect from our lessons
My lessons are beginner-friendly and structured to ensure steady progress regardless of your previous language learning experience. 
🔹 Grammar: Understand and learn the structure of the Swedish language step by step with clear explanations and practical examples.
🔹 Pronunciation: Speak Swedish with confidence using pronunciation exercises to ensure you pronounce each sound correctly and are using the correct intonation.
